'''Tenant'''<ref name="Guide" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Over" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 59: Mortis">{{FactFile2014|59|MOR 1-2|Mortis}}</ref> Tenant and the crew of<ref name="Over" /> his<ref name="Guide" /> [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] were patrolling [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Wild Space/Legends|beyond]] the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] when they intercepted a message from the [[Chrelythiumn system/Legends|Chrelythiumn system]] that contained a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress code]] abandoned by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] more than [[Inter-Sith Wars period|2,000 years prior]]. Tenant subsequently transmitted the message to [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]; the High Council then sent a party to [[Mission to Mortis/Legends|investigate]] its origins. Tenant was a fair-skinned Human with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="Over" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tenant first appeared in the newsreel prelude to "[[Overlords]]," the fifteenth episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season Three]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[January 28]], [[2011]]. Although he went unnamed,<ref name="Over" /> the online guide to the episode identified him as "Tenant."<ref name="Guide" />
